items.title: Bo Nix: I don't know where the disconnect is offensively

items.title: Thursday Night Football: Broncos beat Seahawks 17-14 in overtime

items.title: Police continue to withhold the Josh Jacobs video
items.text: As Packers running back Josh Jacobs continues to spend the early weeks of the 2026 season on paid leave, the NFL reportedly still hasn't gotten access to the key piece of video generated by the incident that resulted in a no-contest plea to battery.

items.title: Jets S Minkah Fitzpatrick will appeal fine for hit on Browns WR KC Concepcion
items.text: Jets safety Minkah Fitzpatrick said he received a fine from the NFL for a hit that concussed Browns wide receiver KC Concepcion on Sunday.

items.title: Troy Aikman: It seems like ESPN is going to go in a different direction
items.text: Hall of Fame quarterback and ESPN/ABC Monday Night Football analyst Troy Aikman made some waves on Thursday morning by creating the clear impression that he's planning to leave after his current contract expires, after Super Bowl LXI.

items.title: Thursday Night Football: Broncos lead Seahawks 14-3 at halftime
